title: Play 100 artifact manifest

workbookPresentation.scoreText: Dark ink on neutral cells and light lime data bars; no lime text on cream.
workbookPresentation.headers: Ink backgrounds with light cream text and restrained lime rules.

source.scope: Mainstream AAA / blockbuster / major-publisher flagship games, plus a small number of AAA-caliber premium exceptions that clearly belong in an essential modern-gaming list. Nintendo excluded.
source.rankingBasis: Curated must-play ranking, not a raw Metacritic leaderboard. Critical acclaim, lasting reputation, industry influence, cultural impact, design quality, production ambition and “must-play” status.

canonical.criticAverage: Arithmetic mean of the available columns after IGN and GameSpot × 10; missing => null; all missing => null.
canonical.rankIndex: 10 - (rank - 1) * 3 / 99; a derived index, not an independent review.
canonical.authorRating: Original numeric value plus exact raw cached text, displayed source value, source cell and number format; all100 are preserved.
canonical.precision: JSON retains full finite Python floating-point precision; workbook displays scores to one decimal without rounding stored values.

differencesAndCleaningDecisions.authoritativeOrder: Preserved all 100 ranks and source titles, studios, years, genres, rationales, and native critic values from AAA Top 50.

authorRatingPreservation.meaning: Leul's original cached ratings, based on his curated rank. Preserve original rounded/text results, values, display, number formats and notes; never substitute the reconstructed curve.

originalFormulaCaveats.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
originalFormulaCaveats.handling: The original cached author value is preserved. The separate legacy rankIndex field is not the author's recorded rating.

authorRatingPreservation.visitorRatings: Separate device-only data. Never seeded from these public author ratings.

differencesAndCleaningDecisions.timelineDecision: The source actually holds 100 titles in two 50-row blocks. Rebuild one complete 100-record chronology from primary years and ranks; do not reinstate obsolete derivative-only titles.

separatorRow.decision: Preserve tier meaning but omit the decorative non-record divider from the native table.

differencesAndCleaningDecisions.genreTags: Split only the existing slash-separated source genre; trim separator-adjacent whitespace without adding classifications.
differencesAndCleaningDecisions.slugs: NFKD ASCII transliteration, remove apostrophes, replace other punctuation/whitespace with single hyphens; assert uniqueness.

artwork.mapping: Resolve drawing relationships and exact anchor-cell titles; do not assume drawing order equals curated order. Review contact sheets against those labels.

uncertaintiesAndLimitations: Scores and source years were not independently reverified. The source provides no reliable critic snapshot date.
Metacritic and Metacritic PC are both included when entered. The normalized average covers entered columns, not independent publications.

Leul's rating is copied from the original cached column L; rank-based provenance is retained. The legacy rankIndex JSON field is a separate internal compatibility value, not a replacement author rating.
